name: MlogiQA
intro: MLogiQA 是 P-MMEval 中由 LogiQA 测试集构建的平行多语言逻辑推理子集：保留原始中英文并将 80 道题翻译、专业复核为十种语言，共 800 条实例。
build_method: LogiQA 平行抽样, GPT-4o 翻译, 专业翻译复核, 本地化与平行对齐
task_type: 逻辑问答, 多语言推理
eval_feature: 十语种平行题, 三种提示设定, 直接答案, 跨语言迁移分析
scale: 80 道平行题 × 10 种语言，共 800 条实例
build_method_en: Parallel LogiQA Sampling, GPT-4o Translation, Professional Translation Review, Localization and Alignment
eval_feature_en: Ten-language Parallel Questions, Three Prompt Settings, Direct Answers, Cross-language Transfer Analysis
intro_en: MLogiQA is P-MMEval's parallel multilingual logical-reasoning subset built from the LogiQA test set: it preserves original English and Chinese and translates and professionally reviews 80 questions into ten languages, yielding 800 instances.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the P-MMEval paper arXiv:2411.09116v2, especially Table 1, Sections 3.1 and 3.3–3.5, Section 4.2, Section 5, and Appendices A and F. The diagram traces the original English/Chinese LogiQA records, first-80 selection, ten languages across seven families, GPT-4o translation of eight missing languages, exhaustive professional review, correction/localization/removal policy, parallel alignment, 80-by-10 release, normalized OpenCompass/lm-eval prompts, English/native/English-few-shot settings, direct JSON answers, Accuracy, and CACR.
